name: 1: 14-day QP and census date reached; retain earnings
description:
Same as AC1 but the apprenticeship starts on the 25th of the month, so the 14-day qualifying window spans April into May. Completion is recorded on exactly day 14 (2026-05-08), which meets the threshold — earnings should be retained. Tests correct day counting across a month boundary. Covers FLP-1424 AC1.

Earnings are not subject to Qualifying Periods for Completion. Completion payment is still payable, along with a Balancing payment to roll-up the remaining earnings.

steps.name: SLD Records Completion (14 days in learning — exactly meets qualifying period, crossing April/May boundary)
